Nobody Believes Her.text: Seeing the truth is only half the terror; the other half is saying it aloud and watching no one listen, the fate of Cassandra in the Greek story. Kaylie Russell [blames an antique mirror for her parents' violent deaths|2013-oculus], while her brother Tim insists it was all ordinary madness. Cole Sear [confides that he sees dead people|1999-the-sixth-sense], and his psychologist believes him only after hearing a hidden voice on an old session tape. The shape belongs mostly to North American films, from Rosemary's Baby to The Invisible Man.

Stray From the Path.text: The slasher is an old warning tale in new clothes: stay on the path, be home before dark, or be taken, as Perrault warned through Little Red Riding Hood and as Malay children are told to be in by maghrib. In Haddonfield [Michael Myers shadows babysitter Laurie Strode|1978-halloween] while her friends laugh off her fears, and in Woodsboro [a caller's chat about horror films turns sadistic|1996-scream]. On Elm Street [the children are hunted for what their parents did|1984-a-nightmare-on-elm-street]. The shape is almost wholly North American and strongest from the 1960s to the 1990s.

The Bad Host.text: Hospitality is one of the oldest promises between strangers, and this story breaks it, so that the warm house and the laid table become the trap, as in Hansel and Gretel or the cave of Polyphemus. Gorgeous takes six friends to her aunt's country house, where [the house begins to eat them|1977-house-hausu]. Chris finds Rose's parents [warm in a way that never quite rings true|2017-get-out], and Brent wakes [bound to a chair in a house decorated like a dance hall|2009-the-loved-ones]. The shape has grown steadily and is commonest in films made since 2015.

The Bargain.text: Every bargain with the dark is a loan, and the story waits for the day it is called in, the old shape of Faust and of the Javanese wealth pacts called pesugihan. Vinayak [lowers himself on a rope to steal gold from a starving god|2018-tumbbad], and Si Bongkok, made handsome by the bunian, [breaks his oath and is offered the devil's false bargain|1958-sumpah-orang-minyak]. In Satan's Slaves [a fertility cult once answered barren women's prayers|2017-satan-s-slaves], and its price was the last child. The four girls in The Craft learn that every spell comes back twisted.

The Beast Within.text: The fear that the animal is already inside us, waiting for the right night, is as old as Lycaon in Ovid and the Malay weretiger. Irena Dubrovna [believes she will become a panther if roused to passion|1942-cat-people], and never consummates her marriage. Vore tells Tina [she is a troll|2018-border] and she starts eating grubs from the trees, while Zaffan's first period brings [a pink-eyed jungle woman only she can see|2023-tiger-stripes]. The same change runs through The Wolf Man, An American Werewolf in London and Ginger Snaps.

The Body Betrays.text: Here the enemy works from inside, rewriting the body one change at a time, a modern descendant of Ovid's Metamorphoses and Kafka's Metamorphosis. In Kurouzu-cho classmates [slow down, sprout shells and climb the school walls|2000-uzumaki], and Justine's rash gives way to [a hunger that drives her to raw chicken|2016-raw]. After her first period Zaffan's [nails start to fall away|2023-tiger-stripes]. The shape runs from The Fly to The Substance, yet it never appears among the British and Irish films in the record.

The Book You Shouldn't Read.text: Some knowledge is a door that opens only one way, and this story punishes whoever reads on, as the Egyptian tale of Setne Khamwas punished the man who took the Book of Thoth. In the cellar of a remote cabin, among rotting animal corpses, [Eric reads an old book's incantation aloud|2013-evil-dead]. In New Orleans [a plumber breaks into a bricked-off space|1981-the-beyond] beneath a hotel built over a gate of hell, and the dead begin to walk. Most of these films were made in the 1980s and 1990s, the years of The Evil Dead and Prince of Darkness.

The Contagion.text: Contagion turns every neighbour into a risk and every touch into a question, a fear as old as the plagues of Egypt. In Wisborg [the town fills with deaths blamed on a plague from the ship|1922-nosferatu]. Activists free a chimpanzee from a Cambridge laboratory and [the rage virus leaps to them within seconds|2002-28-days-later], and on the express to Busan [every bite turns another passenger|2016-train-to-busan]. In When Evil Lurks each warning ignored, like firing a gun at a possessed animal, [lets the evil leap onward|2023-when-evil-lurks].

The Dead Won't Stay Dead.text: Burial is a promise that the dead are finished with us, and this story breaks it, returning them changed, like Izanami in the Kojiki or the Norse draugr. [Asa wakes in her crypt|1960-black-sunday] and calls her lover from the grave, and radio bulletins report [the dead rising across the East Coast|1968-night-of-the-living-dead]. A glowing fog [carries the drowned crew of the Elizabeth Dane|1980-the-fog] back to the town built on their gold. In Rigor Mortis a sweet old widow pays a black magician to bring her dead husband back.

The Descent.text: Going down into the dark is the oldest journey there is, from Inanna and Orpheus onward, and something always follows the traveller back up. Sarah [follows her friends into a cave in the Appalachians|2005-the-descent] where pale, blind creatures hunt by sound, and Ofelia [is led into an ancient stone labyrinth|2006-pan-s-labyrinth] by a fairy. Five police officers [reach an abandoned station that behaves like hell|2015-baskin]. The shape is missing from films before 1960, and in Annihilation it becomes a glimmering zone where time slips and radios die.

The Devouring Mother.text: The one who should protect is the danger here, from the start or because grief has made her so, as in the Greek tales of Medea and Lamia. Amelia, still unable to face her husband's death, finds [new pages in the pop-up book showing her killing the dog, her son and herself|2014-the-babadook]. Norman Bates talks over supper about [his ailing mother|1960-psycho], and Fénix performs in an act where his arms become Concha's hands, until offstage [she orders him to kill every woman he desires|1989-santa-sangre]. Most of these films were made after 2000.

The Double.text: The double strikes at the one certainty we have, that we are ourselves and the people we love are who they seem, the old fear of the German doppelgänger and the Irish fetch. At the Antarctic station an organism [can perfectly imitate any living thing|1982-the-thing], so MacReady trusts no one. At his girlfriend's family home upstate [the Black staff behave eerily|2017-get-out], and in Dead of Night [a mirror shows a husband another man's room|1945-dead-of-night]. The shape stretches from The Student of Prague to Us and The Substance.

The Endless Night.text: Some stories close in a circle, and the horror is the dawning sense that this has all happened before and will happen again, like Sisyphus and his stone or the turning wheel of samsara. Architect Walter Craig [tells the guests at a Kent cottage that he has seen them all in a recurring dream|1945-dead-of-night] that ends in something awful. Every film in the record with this shape is British or Irish: aboard a deserted liner [Jess feels déjà vu as she finds her own keys|2009-triangle], and in Yonder [every road leads Gemma and Tom back to house number 9|2019-vivarium].

The House Remembers.text: Walls outlive the people inside them, and in this story a house keeps the wrong that was done there, a belief as old as Pliny's haunted house at Athens. Hill House is [a mansion where Hugh Crain's wives and daughter all died|1963-the-haunting], and at 112 Ocean Avenue, a year after a family was shot, the Lutzes find [a small red room behind the basement wall|1979-the-amityville-horror]. The Perrons learn [their land bears the curse of a witch who sacrificed her baby|2013-the-conjuring]. In Mahal a photograph falls from the bedroom wall, and the man in it has Shankar's face.

The Hunger.text: This is the appetite that eats the eater, Erysichthon in Ovid or the hungry ghosts of Buddhist belief, and it turns the one who feels it into the monster. Justine, a lifelong vegetarian, moves [from a stolen burger to raw chicken to her sister's severed finger|2016-raw], ashamed of a hunger that runs in the family. Vinayak returns to Tumbbad [hungry for the hidden treasure|2018-tumbbad] of a god who starves for the grain he was denied. The shape is absent before 1980 and most common in films made since 2015.

The Inherited Curse.text: The heir pays for a crime committed before they were born, as the House of Atreus did and as Langkawi did under Mahsuri's curse. Kumar comes to Chandanghat twenty years after [a lustful Thakur drove a young girl to kill herself|1962-bees-saal-baad], and Steven's children [lose the use of their legs|2017-the-killing-of-a-sacred-deer] for a drink he hid long ago. Maya's search for an inheritance in Harjosari [leads back to three murdered girls|2019-impetigore]. The shape grows across the century and is proportionally commonest in East and Southeast Asian films.

The One Who Feeds.text: The dead who live on the living are the most intimate of monsters, because they need us, from the Malay penanggalan to the Romanian strigoi. Cathy Kean's head [tears free, trailing its organs, to devour an unborn baby|1981-mystics-in-bali], and a Serbian family waits for old Gorca to come back from hunting [a wurdalak, a vampire that preys on the people it loved|1963-black-sabbath]. In Blackeberg [Håkan kills to bring Eli blood|2008-let-the-right-one-in]. Strong through most of the century, the shape nearly vanishes from films made since 2015.

The Rule.text: Survival hangs on a single rule, don't look, don't speak, don't move, and the whole story waits for the moment it is broken, as it was by Lot's wife and by Orpheus. The young woodcutter in Kwaidan [is spared on condition he never speaks of that night|1964-kwaidan], and years later, by candlelight, he tells the story. Ofelia [is set three tasks by a faun|2006-pan-s-labyrinth], and a tape [orders Lawrence to kill Adam by six o'clock|2004-saw]. The shape is missing before 1960 and grows after 2000.

The Thing Outside.text: Something waits beyond the wall and hunts whoever steps outside, the shape of Grendel and of the Minotaur in its maze. In the Australian outback [a giant razorback boar smashes through Jake Cullen's house|1984-razorback] and carries off his grandson, and Ben [boards up the farmhouse windows against a growing horde|1968-night-of-the-living-dead]. In Seoul a creature [storms through Hangang Park|2006-the-host] and takes Hyun-seo. Behind a vast stone wall on an uncharted island, [the islanders offer Ann Darrow to Kong|1933-king-kong].

The Thing We Made.text: Every maker fears the day the work stops obeying, the dread behind the Golem of Prague and the Greek tales of Prometheus and Talos. Dr. Moreau [surgically shapes animals into people|1932-island-of-lost-souls] who chant his Law and scatter at the crack of his whip. Years after an American pathologist [has formaldehyde poured down a drain|2006-the-host], a creature born of the poisoned Han River storms through Seoul. The shape belongs above all to the early decades of Frankenstein and The Invisible Man, and has almost disappeared since 2015.

The Thing You Took Home.text: A souvenir, a lucky find, a stolen trinket: this story begins when something comes home that should have stayed where it was, like Pandora's jar or the Monkey's Paw. A nurse preparing a body for burial [slips a valuable ring from the corpse|1963-black-sabbath], and Joy [hangs a mirror left on a bus at her front door|2004-feng-shui]. Ellison Oswalt [finds a box of Super 8 reels in the attic|2012-sinister] and watches them night after night. In Ringu the object is a videotape, and [Reiko's seven days begin the moment she plays it|1998-ringu].

The Village Needs Blood.text: A community that buys its safety with one life is doing an old and terrible arithmetic, the story of Iphigenia and of Jephthah's daughter. On a remote Welsh island the founders [swear that blood sacrifice made the barren soil fertile|2018-apostle]. The Le Domas in-laws are sure [they must sacrifice Grace before dawn or die themselves|2019-ready-or-not], and Martin [calmly demands a life from Steven's own family|2017-the-killing-of-a-sacred-deer]. The shape has grown sharply since 2000, and British and Irish films return to it often.

The Voice Inside.text: The worst voice to hear is a stranger's coming out of someone you love, the dybbuk of Ashkenazi folklore or the jinn possession known in Malay as rasukan. Regan [speaks in a voice that is not hers|1973-the-exorcist], and in Adelaide a party game turns on the words [I let you in|2022-talk-to-me], after which a dead stranger takes the speaker's body. In Dakar [the lost men return at night inside the bodies of the living|2019-atlantics]. The shape has grown fast since 2000 and travels further than most, from South Asia to Sub-Saharan Africa, while British and Irish films barely touch it.

The Witch at the Edge of the Woods.text: The witch lives just outside the community, feared for her power and still sought out in secret, like Baba Yaga, Circe or the Malay Nenek Kebayan. In 1630s New England [a witch steals baby Samuel|2015-the-witch] from a farm at the edge of the forest, and Cathy Kean [seeks out the cackling Queen of the Leák|1981-mystics-in-bali] for her book. Suzy Bannion learns her dance academy [was founded by a Greek émigrée said to be a witch|1977-suspiria]. The shape has surged in films made since 2015.

The Woman Who Comes Back.text: A woman wronged in life returns from death to collect what she is owed, the shape of the Malay pontianak, of Oiwa in Yotsuya Kaidan and of La Llorona. Natre, the shy student Tun once loved in secret, [surfaces as a pale face in his photographs|2004-shutter], and in Chanderi [a woman's spirit takes the men and leaves only their clothes|2018-stree]. A poor swordsman [comes home to a tender welcome from the wife he abandoned|1964-kwaidan] that does not last until morning. Most of these films come from East, Southeast and South Asia, and the shape is rare in North America.

The Wrong Child.text: A child should be the plainest truth in a house, so a child who is somehow wrong unsettles everything, the old fear of the changeling and the Malay toyol. Miles, [sent home from boarding school, is charming beyond his years|1961-the-innocents], and the Hitchens family are handed [an old book about fairies who steal babies and leave changelings|2015-the-hallow]. In Venice John keeps glimpsing [a small figure in a red coat like his drowned daughter's|1973-don-t-look-now]. British and Irish films return to this shape far more often than any others.

You Invited It In.text: The vampire of European folklore cannot cross a threshold unless it is asked, and this story is about the asking, the small courtesy that lets the danger in. In Blackeberg [Eli asks to be invited in|2008-let-the-right-one-in], and at a lakeside holiday home a polite young man [comes to the kitchen to borrow eggs|1997-funny-games]. At a party in Adelaide each player grips an embalmed hand and [says I let you in|2022-talk-to-me]. One night Sam asks his mother [to read a pop-up book called Mister Babadook|2014-the-babadook].
